disease_state: Skin prick test (SPT) solutions and allergy vaccines (AVs) are crucial tools for diagnosis and therapy of allergies.
material_type: commercial dust mite skin prick test solutions and allergy vaccines
Proteomic profiling of commercial dust mite skin prick test solutions and allergy vaccines from India☆
sample_source: All samples were purchased by collaborating physicians in India from local vendors and shipped to Europe under temperature-controlled conditions at 4 °C.
species: Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus, Dermatophagoides farinae, Suidasia medanensis, Cicer arietinum, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Homo sapiens, Blomia tropicalis

From the 5 Indian Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus products, none contained proteins from this source. Instead, 1 sample contained Dermatophagoides farinae and human serum proteins, 4 products contained allergens from the storage mite Suidasia medanensis, allergens from the legume Cicer arietinum (chickpea), and proteins from baker's yeast.
